entities.summary: Zhang Xuan (713–755) was a Chinese painter who lived during the Tang dynasty (618–907). As a prominent artist of his time, he was known for his expertise in landscape painting and his ability to capture the essence of the natural world. His work was highly regarded by the imperial court, and he was often invited to create murals and paintings for important events and ceremonies. Zhang Xuan's legacy extended beyond his own lifetime, as his techniques and styles influenced later generations of Chinese artists. His works can still be seen in museums and private collections today, providing a glimpse into the artistic and cultural heritage of the Tang dynasty. The intricate details and subtle colors in his paintings reflect the high level of craftsmanship and artistic expertise that characterized this period in Chinese history.
